name: Body in the carrier's cone steps out of the lane

observations.label: ballOwner
observations.trigger: carrier has a runnable lane ahead but a teammate is standing in it
evidence: carrier's head is up and the first defender is more than five yards away
the direct line to the next band is occupied by a team-mate, not an opponent

observations.label: pocketOccupant
observations.trigger: standing inside the cone directly ahead of the ball
evidence: moves perpendicular to the carrying line rather than further forward
clears the lane without dropping into it again as the carry continues
the direction chosen is the side they were already leaning toward

source.note: Authored observation only. No frame images or video are stored in this repository; this records what was seen, not the footage.
